title: Flavio Bolsonaro claims title of Brazil's leader

slides.headline: Flavio Bolsonaro claims title of Brazil's leader
slides.subtitle: He lost the recent election to Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva.

slides.explanation: The election results were final, yet this declaration challenges the established outcome of the national vote.

slides.headline: The claim ignores the official election results
slides.explanation: While Flavio Bolsonaro insists he leads the country, he was defeated by his opponent in the official run-off election.
Five major international news outlets have confirmed the election results and the subsequent statements made by Flavio Bolsonaro.

slides.subtitle: Read more about the political climate in Brazil on Headlinne.

caption:
Brazil's political landscape is currently seeing a strange moment.

Flavio Bolsonaro has publicly referred to himself as the leader of the country, despite losing the recent presidential election to Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva.

This claim stands in direct opposition to the official electoral results. It highlights a growing divide in the political rhetoric coming from those who lost the vote.

When politicians make claims that contradict official election data, it can cause confusion for the public. We track these stories to help you see past the noise.

story.title: Flavio Bolsonaro insists he is 'leader of Brazil' despite losing election run-off
story.summary: Flavio Bolsonaro has called himself the "leader of Brazil", despite losing the country's election run-off to incumbent president Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva.
